recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white and draw a thin red (#C00000) border around the full slide edge. 2. Draw a large rectangle with red/maroon outline (#C00000), no fill, spanning roughly x 7-93%, y 23-97%. 3. Add a pale yellow (#FFFFCC) rectangle with purple (#7030A0) outline at top-left (x ~10-34%, y ~15-27%), overlapping the frame's top edge; place bold black text 'Pre processing' inside. 4. Add a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with purple outline at top-right containing '31'. 5. Inside the frame near the top, add the line: 'Preprocessing is ' in red bold, followed by 'Problem dependent and data dependent' in black bold italic underlined. 6. Below, add bold black text 'It may include:'. 7. Add 'Gap filling' as a plain (unbulleted) line. 8. Add a round-bulleted list: Thinning, Contour, Binarization, Noise Removal, Color to Gray, Opening touched points, Resizing, Normalization, ...... 9. Use a sans-serif font (e.g., Arial) throughout; body text black, left-aligned.
